theorems.statement: (∀ (N N' k : ℕ) (R : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid N)) k), R.measure univ ≠ ∞ → ∃ Y : (Euclid N → Euclid N') → GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid N')) k, (∀ (F : Euclid N → Euclid N') (Λ : NNReal), LipschitzWith Λ F → IsIntegerMultiplicity (Y F) ∧ ∀ Fs : ℕ → Euclid N → Euclid N', (∀ j, ContDiff ℝ 1 (Fs j)) → (∀ j, LipschitzWith Λ (Fs j)) → TendstoUniformly Fs F atTop → ∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid N')) k, Tendsto (fun j => R.action (fun x => ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid N') k) (Fs j x)).compContinuousLinearMap (fderiv ℝ (Fs j) x))) atTop (𝓝 (Y F ω))) ∧ ∀ (F F' : Euclid N → Euclid N') (Λ : NNReal), LipschitzWith Λ F → LipschitzWith Λ F' → (∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[k].restrict R.carrier), F x = F' x) → Y F = Y F') → ∀ P : ℕ, ∃ homot : ∀ k : ℕ, (Euclid P → Euclid P) → (Euclid P → Euclid P) → GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) k → GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (k + 1), ∀ (k : ℕ) (Λ : NNReal) (F G : Euclid P → Euclid P) (E : Set (Euclid P)) (X : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) k), LipschitzWith Λ F → LipschitzWith Λ G → IsCompact E → IsIntegerMultiplicity X → (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) k, Disjoint (tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k)) E → X ω = 0) → IsIntegerMultiplicity (homot k F G X) ∧ (∀ F' G' : Euclid P → Euclid P, LipschitzWith Λ F' → LipschitzWith Λ G' → EqOn F F' E → EqOn G G' E → homot k F G X = homot k F' G' X) ∧ (∀ (Fs Gs : ℕ → Euclid P → Euclid P) (ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (k + 1)) (ηs : ℕ → TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) k), (∀ j, ContDiff ℝ 1 (Fs j)) → (∀ j, ContDiff ℝ 1 (Gs j)) → (∀ j, LipschitzWith Λ (Fs j)) → (∀ j, LipschitzWith Λ (Gs j)) → TendstoUniformly Fs F atTop → TendstoUniformly Gs G atTop → (∀ j, ∀ x ∈ E, (ηs j : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k) x = ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, (((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (k + 1)) (Fs j x + t • (Gs j x - Fs j x))).curryLeft (Gs j x - Fs j x)).compContinuousLinearMap (fderiv ℝ (Fs j) x + t • (fderiv ℝ (Gs j) x - fderiv ℝ (Fs j) x))) → Tendsto (fun j => X (ηs j)) atTop (𝓝 (homot k F G X ω))) ∧ (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (k + 1), Disjoint (tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (k + 1))) {y : Euclid P | ∃ x ∈ E, ∃ t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, y = F x + t • (G x - F x)} → homot k F G X ω = 0) ∧ ∀ δ : ℝ, (∀ x ∈ E, dist (F x) (G x) ≤ δ) → (homot k F G X).mass ≤ ENNReal.ofReal δ * (2 * (Λ : ℝ≥0∞)) ^ k * X.mass
